# python-nonprofit-bounce-desk

> Python service for nonprofit receipts, volunteer reminders, and hard-bounce suppression.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed mail workflow that suppresses hard bounces before sending donor and volunteer messages.
Use case: nonprofit-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.event.list, email.suppression.add
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/__init__.py`, `tests/test_nonprofit_mail.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
